svg.title: How I build
svg.desc: A terminal types each step, then a short reply follows. Find something annoying. Figure out what the model actually needs. Give the agent something to do. Try to make it fail. Check if it actually got better. Ship it. See what happens. Fix the weird stuff.

g.text: If I keep doing it manually, I’ll probably automate it.
Figure out what the model actually needs
More context isn’t always better context.
Give the agent something to do
If it needs an API, let it call the API.
The happy path is usually the easy part.
Check if it actually got better
At some point you have to stop tweaking and let someone use it.
Production has a way of finding the bugs you missed.
Then do it all over again.
